title: Dorman Help 76970 OER Window Crank Handle 1978-81 Honda Accord Civic & Prelude
description_markdown:
Worn or broken window crank handle leading to difficult window operation? Made of durable material for reliable performance, this window crank handle replaces the original equipment handle.

• Ideal replacement - this window crank handle matches the fit and function of the original equipment component
• Durable construction - this window crank handle is made of durable material to withstand extended use
• Easy to install - this window crank requires no special tools to install
• Versatile design - this window crank handle is suitable for use in various locations in the vehicle

Application Summary:Honda Accord 1981-78, Honda Civic 1981-78, Honda Prelude 1980-79
